name: WF-088 Controlled Communication Outbound Test Gate

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const s=v=>String(v??'').trim(); const channel=s(input.channel).toLowerCase(); const recipient=s(input.recipient??input.to); const message=s(input.message??'Controlled communication runtime test'); const requestId=s(input.request_id??input.external_id); const allowlist=s($env.COMMUNICATION_TEST_RECIPIENT_ALLOWLIST).split(',').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean); const testMode=input.test_mode===true; const dnc=input.dnc===true||input.do_not_contact===true; const gaps=[]; if(!testMode)gaps.push('test_mode=true'); if(!requestId)gaps.push('request_id'); if(!['sms','email'].includes(channel))gaps.push('supported_channel_sms_or_email'); if(!recipient)gaps.push('recipient'); if(!allowlist.includes(recipient))gaps.push('recipient_not_in_test_allowlist'); if(dnc)gaps.push('dnc_suppression'); if(!s($env.COMMUNICATION_RUNTIME_BASE_URL))gaps.push('communication_runtime_base_url'); const allowed=gaps.length===0; return [{json:{ok:allowed,adapter:'wf-088',test:{mode:'controlled_outbound',test_mode:testMode,channel,recipient,message,request_id:requestId,allowlist_match:allowlist.includes(recipient)},authorization:{dispatch_allowed:allowed,explicit_test_mode_required:true,allowlist_required:true,dnc_hard_suppression:true},execution:{idempotency_key:'ai-communication-test:'+channel+':'+(requestId||'missing')+':v1',receipt_required:true,thread_or_conversation_tracking:true},missing_requirements:gaps,next_action:allowed?'Invoke WF-082 with autonomous opt-in and preserve the resulting provider receipt.':'Do not send. Fix the listed test gate requirements.',policy:{no_arbitrary_recipients:true,no_production_test_mode_bypass:true,no_secrets_in_payload:true,provider_credentials_outside_github:true}}}}];

const gate=$('Validate Controlled Test Gate').first().json; const status=Number($response.statusCode||0); const receipt=$json; const sent=status>=200&&status<300&&receipt.dispatch_result?.status==='sent'; return [{json:{...gate,dispatch_result:{status:sent?'sent':'failed',http_status:status,provider_receipt:receipt,receipt_required:true},next_action:sent?'Controlled provider receipt received; verify CRM activity, thread continuity and idempotency before enabling production traffic.':'No successful send receipt; do not mark the test as passed. Investigate runtime/provider failure using the preserved idempotency key.'}}}];
